```{r}
# CREATE FULL SECTOR DATASET AND REDUCED SUPERSECTOR DATASET

d_f <- read_csv(here("Superinvestor Reduced.csv"))
superinvestor_dataset <- read_csv(here("Superinvestor Data (work).csv"))
```

```{r}
# CREATE REDUCED SUPERSECTOR DATASET

superinvestor_reduced <- data.frame(
  Superinvestor = d_f[,1],
  Cyclical = d_f[,4] + d_f[,5] + d_f[,7] + d_f[11] + d_f[,12],
  Defensive = d_f[,3] + d_f[,8] + d_f[,10],
  Sensitive = d_f[,2] + d_f[,6] + d_f[,9]
)

colnames(superinvestor_reduced) <- c("Superinvestor", "Cyclical", "Defensive", "Sensitive")
```

```{r}
glimpse(superinvestor_reduced)
```

```{r}
# BASIC VISUALISATION: TERNARY DIAGRAM OF REDUCED DATASET WITH PC1 LINE SHOWN TO ILLUSTRATE AITCHISON GEOMETRY

X <- superinvestor_reduced[,2:4]

ternaryDiag(X, line = "pca", col = "red", cex = 1)
```

```{r}
# CORRELATION ANALYSIS OF FULL DATASET

X <- as.data.frame(superinvestor_dataset[,2:13])
X[X==0] <- 0.001

D <- ncol(X)
par(mfrow = c(D, D), mar = c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1))
pearson_corr <- matrix(NA, ncol = D, nrow = D)
spearman_corr <- matrix(NA, ncol = D, nrow = D)

diag(pearson_corr) <- rep(1, D)
diag(spearman_corr) <- rep(1, D)

for (i in 1:D){
  for (j in 1:D){ 
    if (i==j){
      plot(0, 0, type = "n", xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n")
      text(0, 0, names(X[i])) 
    }
    else{
      Z <- pivotCoord(X[, c(i, j, (1:D)[-c(i, j)])], method = "symm") 
      plot(Z[, 1:2],
        xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", type = "n") 
      text(Z[, 1], Z[, 2], cex = 0.7)
      pearson_corr[i,j] <- cor(Z[, 1:2])[1, 2]
      spearman_corr[i,j] <- cor(Z[, 1:2], method = "spearman")[1, 2]
    } 
  }
}
```

```{r}
library("gplots")
rgbcol <- colorRampPalette(c("blue4","turquoise","white","orange","red4"), space = "rgb")

heatmap.2(as.matrix(pearson_corr), Rowv = FALSE, symm = TRUE, col = rgbcol(256),
          key = TRUE, trace = "none", main = "Pearson correlation",
          margins = c(4, 4), cexRow = 1.2, cexCol = 1.2) 

heatmap.2(as.matrix(spearman_corr), Rowv = FALSE, symm = TRUE, col = rgbcol(256),
          key = TRUE, trace = "none", main = "Spearman correlation",
          margins = c(4, 4), cexRow = 1.2, cexCol = 1.2)
```

```{r}
calculate_bic <- function(kmeans_input, dataset) {
  n <- nrow(dataset)
  k <- length(unique(kmeans_input$cluster))
  d <- ncol(dataset)
  total_withinss <- sum(kmeans_input$withinss)
  bic <- n * log(total_withinss / n) + k * log(n) * d
  return(bic)
}
```

set.seed(123)
X <- as.data.frame(superinvestor_dataset[,2:13])

```{r}
# FUNCTION TO CALCULATE OPTIMAL K: ELBOW METHOD

withinss_hier_clust <- function(hc, k) {
  clusters <- cutree(hc, k)
  ss <- sum(sapply(unique(clusters), function(c) {
    clustered_dataset <- Z[clusters == c, ]
    sum(dist(clustered_dataset)^2) / (2 * nrow(clustered_dataset))
  }))
  return(ss)
}


k_values <- 1:10
withinss_values <- sapply(k_values, function(k) withinss_hier_clust(ward_result, k))


plot(k_values, withinss_values, type = "b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE,
     xlab = "Number of clusters K",
     ylab = "Total within-clusters sum of squares")
```

```{r}
# LONG PROCESS TO VALIDATE WARD CLUSTERING CHOICE OF K: REPLACE K WITH EACH POSSIBLE VALUE

k_values <- 2:12
hartigan_indices <- numeric(length(k_values))
ch_indices <- numeric(length(k_values))



for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
  k <- k_values[i]
  X <- as.data.frame(superinvestor_dataset[,2:13])
  X[X==0] <- 0.001
  Z <- pivotCoord(X)

  ward_result <- WARD(Z)
  ward_clusters <- cutree(ward_result, k = k)

  all_clusters <- split(as.data.frame(Z), ward_clusters)
  
  average_list <- lapply(all_clusters, function(cluster_matrix) colMeans(as.matrix(cluster_matrix)))
  
  average_matrix <- do.call(rbind, average_list)
  
  v_bar <- colMeans(average_matrix)
  
  Bnc <- sum(apply(average_matrix, 1, function(row) sum((row - v_bar)^2)))
  
  Wnc <- sum(sapply(all_clusters, function(cluster_matrix){
    cluster_center <- colMeans(as.matrix(cluster_matrix))
    sum(apply(cluster_matrix, 1, function(row) sum((row - cluster_center)^2)))
  }))
  
  Hnc <- log(Bnc / Wnc)
  CHnc <- (Bnc/(k-1)) / (Wnc/(n-k))
  
  hartigan_indices[i] <- Hnc
  ch_indices[i] <- CHnc

}

plot(k_values, hartigan_indices, type = 'b', col = 'blue', xlab = 'Number of Clusters (k)', ylab = 'Index Value', main = 'Hartigan Indices')

plot(k_values, ch_indices, type = 'b', col = 'red', xlab = 'Number of Clusters (k)', ylab = 'Index Value', main = 'Calinski-Harabasz Indices')

```

```{r}
calculate_ward_bic <- function(data, clusters, k) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  d <- ncol(data)
  withinss <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    clustered_dataset <- data[clusters == i, ]
    if (nrow(clustered_dataset) > 0) {
      cluster_center <- colMeans(clustered_dataset)
      withinss <- withinss + sum(rowSums((clustered_dataset - cluster_center) ^ 2))
    }
  }
  
  bic <- n * log(withinss / n) + k * log(n) * d
  return(bic)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
X <- as.data.frame(superinvestor_dataset[,2:13])
X[X==0] <- 0.001
Z <- pivotCoord(X)

ward_result <- WARD(Z)
ward_clusters <- cutree(ward_result, k = 5)

calculate_ward_bic(Z, ward_clusters, 5)
```
